articles.headline: Ross Chastain wins Straight Talk Wireless 400 (NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Ross Chastain won Straight Talk Wireless 400 (NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P12 and leading 53 laps. Daniel Suárez finished second and Ryan Preece was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 10 cautions.

Ryan Preece was the biggest mover, gaining 24 spots from P27 to P3.

Joey Logano leads the championship with 1249 points, 69 ahead of Ty Gibbs.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
